newsitem.title: UK: Amoco sells Polish petrol stations to Texaco.
newsitem.headline: Amoco sells Polish petrol stations to Texaco.

text.p: Amoco Corp said on Tuesday it had completed its withdrawal from petrol retailing in central Europe by agreeing to sell its embryonic Polish network to Texaco Inc.
Commercial terms of the sale, which is subject to Polish government approval, were not disclosed.
Amoco Poland has to date opened three combined petrol/convenience store outlets, leased another and completed construction of a further eight.
It also acquired 33 sites for development.
Amoco announced in October 1996 it planned to end its investment in petrol retailing in Poland, Romania and Bulgaria.
Earlier this year it sold its petroleum retailing operations in Romania and Bulgaria to Hungarian State Oil Company MOL and Shell Bulgaria respectively.
